ARRIVAL — a ship descends through the atmosphere or breaches the horizon; the world is being entered for the first time. Engine glow, atmospheric ionization, the cinematic moment of crossing the threshold.

DISCOVERY — a figure has paused at the edge of something unknown — a ruin, a portal, a wonder. The pose carries surprise, reverence, hesitation. The scene captures the heartbeat before the figure decides what to do next.
DEPARTURE — a silhouette walks or rides AWAY from the camera toward a distant impossible structure. The journey is just beginning. The vastness ahead implies the smallness of the figure.
ASCENT — figure or craft climbing — up a cliff, up a tower, up through clouds toward an orbital structure. The vertical pull dominates. The destination is glimpsed above, not yet reached.

THREAT — something colossal is gathering, emerging, looming. Storm clouds curling around a peak. A creature surfacing from depths. A ship the size of a city sliding into orbit overhead. The scene is the moment before consequence.
AWE — figure rendered TINY (1-3% of frame) against monumental scale. The composition exists to convey overwhelming scale. The figure's role is witness, not protagonist.
RUIN — encountering remnants of a fallen civilization. Half-collapsed megastructures, statues toppled and overgrown, machinery dormant for centuries. Atmosphere is melancholy + reverent.
CONFRONTATION — face-to-face with the alien Other. A figure stands before a colossal alien entity, an inscrutable monolith, an opening into the unknown. The frame is the moment of meeting.
VIGIL — figure stands still at a high vantage, watching. A lone watcher above a city, a sentinel on a wall, a guardian by a portal. Time stretched and quiet. Light reveals the world slowly.
EXODUS — a procession or convoy moves across the frame. Many ships, many figures. The journey is collective. Migration, pilgrimage, evacuation, return.
CONVERGENCE — multiple ships descending toward the same landing site, beams of light meeting at a central point, fleet formations approaching a shared destination. Action by accumulation.
SOLITUDE — a single figure or single ship occupies the frame against an empty world. No witness, no audience — pure cinematic loneliness. The world dwarfs them but is also their only companion.
RECKONING — a figure stands amid the aftermath of catastrophe, surveying what has been lost or what they have caused, deciding whether to flee or atone.
BREACH — the moment a barrier fails, a hull punctures, a sealed door gives way; chaos is about to flood in.
COMMUNION — two beings or consciousnesses touch, merge, or communicate across impossible distance or difference; boundaries dissolve.
IGNITION — engines roar to life, weapons charge, systems come online; the instant before action becomes inevitable.
ECLIPSE — something vast moves to obscure the light, casting shadow over a figure or world; darkness arrives with intention.
WITNESS — a figure observes something forbidden or cosmic, recording or simply watching, knowing they cannot intervene.
THRESHOLD — standing at the exact point of no return, one foot in the old world, one in the new, the choice crystallized.
REAWAKENING — emerging from stasis, sleep, death, or forgetting; the slow return to consciousness in an unfamiliar time.
DESCENT — plunging downward into depths, darkness, or danger; falling or diving with purpose or desperation.
TRANSMISSION — sending or receiving a signal across the void; a figure at a console, antenna pointed skyward, waiting for response.
SACRIFICE — the moment of willing loss, a figure stepping forward to give themselves so others may survive or escape.
GENESIS — witnessing or catalyzing the birth of something new: a world, a species, an intelligence, a universe coming into being.
PURSUIT — the hunter closes on the hunted, or the hunted feels the breath of the pursuer; distance collapses between them.
RECURSION — a figure glimpses themselves across time, dimensions, or simulations; the uncanny moment of meeting one's own existence.
SCHISM — the instant of betrayal, separation, or fracture; allies become enemies, unity shatters, what was whole divides.
RESONANCE — a figure reacts to a frequency, a memory, a psychic echo; something distant calling to something within.
ASSEMBLY — disparate elements gathering together with purpose: a fleet forming, a congregation amassing, pieces joining into a whole.
NULLIFICATION — systems failing, powers draining, existence canceling; a figure losing what defined them, unmade by force or choice.
EMERGENCE — something breaks the surface, exits the portal, manifests from nothing; the first glimpse of what was hidden.
CALCULUS — a commander or AI weighing impossible choices, fingers hovering over controls, the decision that will damn or save thousands.
REMNANT — a lone survivor or artifact persists in emptiness; the last trace of what existed, bearing witness to absence.
HARBINGER — a figure or sign appears announcing what comes next; the messenger of transformation, doom, or salvation arriving.
CHRYSALIS — a figure or world in the midst of transformation, neither what it was nor what it will become, suspended in metamorphosis.
INVITATION — an open doorway, an extended hand, a broadcast signal; the offering of entry, alliance, or passage into something beyond.
SUMMONS — a figure receives the call, a signal pierces the void, an ancient beacon awakens; they turn toward something that demands their presence.
INVOCATION — hands raised, technology activated, a ritual begun; the character is calling something forth from beyond the known.
COLLAPSE — structures fall, systems fail, a world ends; a figure witnesses the moment everything comes crashing down around them.
AWAKENING — eyes open for the first time, cryo-pod releasing steam, consciousness returning after centuries; the world has moved on without them.
RESURRECTION — a figure rises from death, from deletion, from the void; what was lost is being pulled back into existence.
ACTIVATION — a hand hovers over a control, a key turns, a sequence begins; the frozen moment before an irreversible choice becomes action.
SURRENDER — weapons lower, hands raise, or a figure kneels; the moment of yielding to greater force, wisdom, or inevitability.
SINGULARITY — all paths, all ships, all eyes converge on a single point in space; the moment before collision, connection, or catastrophic union.
METAMORPHOSIS — a figure or world caught mid-transformation; half-human and half-other, half-ruined and half-reborn, frozen in the agony or ecstasy of change.
EXTRACTION — a desperate retrieval under pressure; pulling someone from a wreck, a pod ejecting, a teleport sequence beginning as danger closes in.
TRANSFORMATION — a body or mind in the process of changing into something else; the halfway point between human and other.
PROSECUTION — a trial, an interrogation, a judgment; a figure stands accused before authority, alien or human, awaiting verdict.
CALIBRATION — a scientist, engineer, or pilot making minute adjustments to crucial equipment; intense focus on the technical before the critical moment.
SALVAGE — picking through the remains of what came before; a figure searches wreckage, ruins, or debris for something precious or necessary.
INCURSION — the first penetration into enemy or forbidden territory; crossing the boundary, entering the exclusion zone, passing the point of no return.
BIFURCATION — two paths diverge and a choice must be made now; the party splits, the timeline branches, the doors lead to different fates.
TESTIMONY — a survivor recounts what they witnessed; speaking to cameras, to investigators, to anyone who will listen about the unbelievable truth.
GESTATION — something growing in a tank, a pod, a chamber; the unborn, the engineered, the cloned suspended in fluid and light.
CASCADING — systems failing in sequence, dominoes falling, the crisis spreading; a figure watches multiple screens as control slips away.
INTERCESSION — arriving just in time to stop something; a hand catching a wrist, a ship dropping into the firing line, a voice calling out "wait.
ENTOMBMENT — being sealed in, buried, trapped; the door closing, the cave-in settling, the prison locking with finality.
MIGRATION — a mass of people or ships moving as one toward survival or hope; the caravan, the fleet, the exodus of thousands.
NEGOTIATION — two opposing forces at the table, in the airlock, on the border; words exchanged when violence hangs ready in the balance.
APOGEE — the highest point reached before the fall; standing at the summit, the empire at its peak, the moment before everything changes.
REKINDLING — hands working to repair something thought lost, coaxing a dying system back to life, restoring power or hope through desperate ingenuity.
INHERITANCE — a figure receives something passed down—a weapon, a key, a mantle of responsibility—accepting the weight of what came before.
SUBMERSION — descending into liquid, atmosphere, or data; a figure passes beneath the surface of an alien ocean or immerses into a virtual space.
MANIFESTATION — something impossible becomes real before our eyes; a hologram solidifies, a thought takes form, a dimensional rift births something new.
TRIBUNAL — a figure stands judged, surrounded by observers or accusers, awaiting a verdict from human or alien authority that will determine their fate.
RENUNCIATION — a figure deliberately destroys or discards something of power—casting away a weapon, refusing technology, walking away from control.
SYNCHRONIZATION — multiple figures move as one, minds linked or training perfected, acting in unified purpose as individual boundaries dissolve.
CASCAADE — a figure realizes one failure is triggering many; watching systems fail in sequence, dominos falling, a chain reaction beginning.
BARGAIN — two parties face each other across a table or wasteland, the moment negotiation begins for something neither wants to surrender.
SEVERANCE — a connection being deliberately cut; a figure pulls the plug, severs the neural link, cuts the tether, choosing separation over continuation.
CORONATION — a figure assumes power or position, elevated above others by ceremony or circumstance, becoming something larger than themselves.
DISSOLUTION — a figure or structure begins to unmake itself, particles scattering, form losing cohesion, the visible process of becoming nothing.
RECOGNITION — the sudden understanding shows on a face, the twist revealed, the pattern seen, the traitor identified, the truth comprehended.
ANCHORING — a figure braces against impossible force, holding a position against wind or gravity or pull, muscles straining, refusing to let go.
EJECTION — violent expulsion from safety into void, a body tumbling through space, cast out from the ship or station into the black.
CASCADE — systems fail in sequence, dominos of disaster, one explosion triggering the next as a figure races against spreading destruction.
DETONATION — the frozen moment before explosion, the visible shockwave expanding, figures silhouetted against the bloom of destructive light.
RECLAMATION — nature or machine overtakes what humanity built, vines through corridors, rust consuming metal, the world taking back what was taken.
ILLUMINATION — sudden light reveals what was hidden, floodlights snap on, a star ignites, bioluminescence blooms, and everything is made visible.
TRANSFIGURATION — a body changes state before our eyes, human becoming something else, matter reshaping, the transformation captured mid-metamorphosis.
REVIVAL — the figure's eyes open after long sleep, after death, after stasis; consciousness returns to a world that has moved on without them.
ARCHIVE — a figure stands before the collected memory of a dead civilization, data streams flowing, ghosts speaking from storage; history demands attention.
SIGNAL — a transmission reaches out across the void, a beacon pulses, a message sent without knowing if anyone listens; hope broadcast into silence.
CORRUPTION — the wrongness spreads, the infection grows, the system fails; something pure is being twisted and the figure watches it happen.
REFLECTION — a figure faces their clone, their AI mirror, their alternate self; identity fragments across multiple versions of the same person.
RESTORATION — broken technology hums back to life, dead systems wake, the ancient machine remembers its purpose; what was dormant is being healed.
JUDGMENT — a figure stands before the tribunal, the AI god, the alien council; their worth and their fate are being determined by powers beyond them.
FRAGMENTATION — the structure breaks apart, the formation scatters, unity dissolves into chaos; what was whole is now flying in a thousand directions.
COALESCENCE — separate elements draw together, particles align, the pattern forms from chaos; something new is being born from disparate pieces.
SANCTUARY — a fragile haven carved from hostile vastness; the small place of safety surrounded by infinite danger.
OFFERING — an exchange proposed across the void; gifts, sacrifices, or bargains extended toward the unknown or the powerful.
